description: Defines font management, text rendering, and UI label functions for the Wesnoth game, including font sizes, colors, markup, and floating label handling.

classes.name: font::manager
classes.description: Manages initialization and cleanup of font-related structures.

classes.name: font::subset_descriptor
classes.description: Describes a font and its Unicode subset.

methods.name: set_font_list
methods.description: Sets the list of fonts to be used.

methods.name: relative_size
methods.description: Calculates font size relative to normal size.

methods.name: draw_text
methods.description: Draws text within a specified area with markup support.

methods.name: text_area
methods.description: Calculates the size of the text if drawn.

methods.name: get_rendered_text
methods.description: Returns a surface with the rendered text.

methods.name: measure_ucs2_text_line
methods.description: Measures width and height of a UCS2 text line.

methods.name: get_max_height
methods.description: Returns maximum font height in pixels.

methods.name: is_format_char
methods.description: Checks if a character is a format character.

methods.name: line_width
methods.description: Calculates width of a line of text.

methods.name: line_size
methods.description: Calculates size of a line of text.

methods.name: word_wrap_text
methods.description: Wraps text to fit within max width and height.

methods.name: make_text_ellipsis
methods.description: Truncates text with ellipsis to fit max width.

methods.name: draw_wrapped_text
methods.description: Draws text with automatic wrapping.

methods.name: floating_label_context
methods.description: Context manager for floating labels.

methods.name: add_floating_label
methods.description: Adds a floating label to the screen.

methods.name: move_floating_label
methods.description: Moves a floating label.

methods.name: scroll_floating_labels
methods.description: Scrolls all labels with map scroll mode.

methods.name: remove_floating_label
methods.description: Removes a floating label.

methods.name: show_floating_label
methods.description: Shows or hides a floating label.

methods.name: get_floating_label_text
methods.description: Retrieves text of a floating label.

methods.name: get_floating_label_rect
methods.description: Gets rectangle of a floating label.

methods.name: draw_floating_labels
methods.description: Draws all floating labels.

methods.name: undraw_floating_labels
methods.description: Removes all floating labels from display.

methods.name: load_font_config
methods.description: Loads font configuration settings.

methods.name: text_to_lines
methods.description: Splits long text into multiple lines.
